Position: Senior Dot Net Developer

Location: Karachi

Job Role Summary:
As a Senior Dot NET Developer, you will be supporting the development and maintenance of software solutions tailored to the specific needs of asset management operations. You will work closely with teams to understand business requirements and translate them into functional software components.
 
Key Responsibilities:
- Design, code, test and manage various applications.

- Follow outlined standards of quality related to code and systems.

- Develop automated tests and conduct performance-tuning.

- Developing web-based applications in .NET, Angular, C#, HTML, JavaScript, ASP.

- Working with MS SQL Server and MySQL. 

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or relevant field.

Experience:
4 to 5 years of experience utilizing the .NET software framework.
Interested candidates can apply at careers@jsil.com mentioning “Senior Dot Net Developer” in the email subject line.

🚀 We're Hiring: Node.js Developer (1–2 Years Exp.)
Company: Bitrupt
Location: Saddar, Karachi (Near Press Club) – On-site

The Role
We aren't looking for a corporate robot. We need a rising backend builder who lives in Node.js, breathes APIs, and is ready to write code that actually impacts real products. If you have 1 to 2 years of solid experience and love solving puzzles behind the screen, let’s talk.

What You’ll Bring to the Table
Node.js Mastery: You know your way around Express.js (or NestJS) and event-driven architecture.
Database Comfort: You can talk to MongoDB or SQL databases without breaking a sweat.
API Crafting: You build clean, secure, and fast RESTful APIs.
Problem-Solving: You don't just find bugs; you crush them.

Why Bitrupt?
Work right in the heart of Karachi (Saddar), easily accessible from anywhere.
Fast-paced environment with zero corporate red tape.
Massive room for quick professional and financial growth.

Drop Your Specs!
📧 Email: Send your resume to careers@bitrupt.co
👉 Use Subject: Node.js Developer - [Your Name]
📞 WhatsApp / Call: 0303-2518858

Hiring: *Frontend Engineer* (React / Next.js / TypeScript) 
📍 Employment Type: Full-Time 
💼 Experience Required: 4+ Years 
 Location: *Karachi (Hybrid/Remote)* 

About the Role
 Were looking for a highly skilled Frontend Engineer with deep expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript to help build fast, accessible, and scalable web applications. In this role, you'll take ownership of features from concept to deployment, collaborating closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver exceptional user experiences.
 Key Responsibilities
✅ Build and maintain production-grade applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript ✅ Design reusable, scalable, and well-tested frontend architectures 
✅ Implement SSR, SSG, and ISR using the Next.js App Router 
✅ Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while managing client/server state efficiently 
✅ Optimize applications for performance, accessibility (WCAG), and SEO
✅ Convert Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive user interfaces 
✅ Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and participate in code reviews 
✅ Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and frontend tooling improvements

 Required Qualifications 
✔ 4+ years of professional frontend development experience 
✔ Expert-level proficiency in React and modern JavaScript (ES6+) 
✔ Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript in production environments 
✔ Extensive experience with Next.js (App Router, routing, rendering strategies, data fetching) 
✔ Solid understanding of state management tools such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, and TanStack Query (React Query) 
✔ Experience with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or CSS-in-JS solutions
 ✔ Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows 
✔ Experience with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright 

Nice to Have 
➕ Experience working with monorepos (Turborepo, Nx) 
➕ Familiarity with Node.js and full-stack development 
➕ Knowledge of design systems and component libraries (Radix UI, shadcn/ui, MUI) 
➕ Experience with GraphQL (Apollo, urql) 
➕ Exposure to cloud platforms such as Vercel or AWS and observability tools

 How to Apply 
Send your resume to afshan.iqbal@conurets.com

Hiring: Full-Stack Web Developer

Key Responsibilities:

Develop modern, responsive web applications using React.js / Next.js
Build scalable backend services and RESTful / GraphQL APIs (Node.js or Python/FastAPI)
Integrate AI/ML model APIs and manage inference endpoints
Design and maintain relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes)
Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure
Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices
Monitor application performance, uptime, and optimize for Core Web Vitals
Use AI app builders (Lovable, Replit, v0) to rapidly prototype and scaffold new web features

Requirements:

3+ years of full-stack web development experience
Proficiency in React.js and at least one backend framework (Node.js/Express or Python/FastAPI)
Solid understanding of databases, data modeling, and query optimization
Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic Kubernetes orchestration
Familiarity with cloud services: storage, serverless functions, and managed databases
Understanding of web security: OWASP Top 10, OAuth 2.0, JWT
Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with AI development tools: Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable, and Replit — portfolio evidence required

Location: Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi.
Apply now by sending your CV to: hr.talent@ideas.com.pk
